description: This file defines the EmptyResponse class, which represents an HTTP response with no content, commonly used for responses like 204 No Content. It extends the Response class and provides methods to create empty responses with specific headers.

classes.name: EmptyResponse
classes.description: A class representing empty HTTP responses, extending the base Response class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an EmptyResponse with a specified status code (default 204) and headers.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Static method to create an EmptyResponse with specified headers, default status 204.
